mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.4 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which forecasts higher future consumption and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1.4 million, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 110.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real rates and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL exceeds 203.0 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE signals a robust labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises >100k and UNRATE falls >0.2pp, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 370 billion dollars signals strong aggregate demand, which forecasts higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 370 billion, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 111.0 combined with a rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a dual stress of weak output and labor market deterioration, indicating an imminent economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 111.0 and UNRATE > 4.5%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
